title: Delhi High Court refuses to stay conviction of ex-Congress MLA Rajendra Bharti in bank fraud case
description: The Delhi High Court on Friday declined to stay the conviction of former Indian National Congress MLA Rajendra Bharti in a cooperative bank fraud case.Justice Manoj Jain pronounced the order in the case which involves cheating and embezzlement of funds from a rural development bank."We will try to upload judgment (on court website) in an hour or so. Unfortunately for you we are dismissing it," the Court said in open court.Justice Manoj JainRajendra Bharti, a former three-time MLA from the Datia
